test_chunkteacher_normal: test the ChunkTeacher with normal batch sizes and dynamic batching configurations
test_chunkteacher_small_buffer: test the ChunkTeacher with a small buffer across multiple batch size settings
test_chunkteacher_slow_chunk: test the ChunkTeacher with slow chunking and batch size three
